description: Join us as we celebrate 4 Indigenous candidates running for office to represent the people. We are gathering in community to celebrate Gabriel Cervantes (CO HD-31), Consuelo Redhorse (CO HD-13), Teddy McCullough (Denver City Council D-8), and Kristina Badhand (Denver City Council At-Large).
